block.greate_remake.rhodium_plated_palla: Rhodium Plated Palladium Crushing Wheel Controller
greate_remake.jei.fan.info: Tiered fan. Higher tiers use rarer materials, support more network stress and unlock more fan processing.
greate_remake.jei.fan.info2: Tier gate: washing needs LV (tier 1), haunting needs MV (tier 2); an item can only be processed by a fan at least as high as its material tier. Configurable in [fan].
greate_remake.jei.fan.info3: Blowing through water also runs GT's ore washer recipes: crushed ore becomes purified ore, and byproduct chances scale with the fan tier.
greate_remake.jei.gearbox.info: Tiered gearbox. It redirects rotation by 90 degrees; its tier decides the maximum stress of the whole network.
greate_remake.jei.gearbox.info2: The vertical gearbox is the same block placed with a horizontal axis (shafts pointing up/down). Breaking a horizontal-axis gearbox drops this item. Gearboxes have no recipes of their own.
greate_remake.ponder.belt_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Mechanical Belts
greate_remake.ponder.belt_casing.text_2: A wrench can be used to remove the casing
greate_remake.ponder.belt_connector.head: Using Mechanical Belts
greate_remake.ponder.belt_connector.text: Right-Clicking two shafts with a belt item will connect them together
Accidental selections can be canceled with Right-Click while Sneaking
Additional Shafts can be added throughout the Belt
Shafts connected via Belts will rotate with Identical Speed and Direction
Added shafts can be removed using the wrench
Mechanical Belts can be dyed for aesthetic purposes
greate_remake.ponder.belt_directions.tex: Belts cannot connect in arbitrary directions
4. And they can connect vertical shafts horizontally
These are all possible directions. Belts can span any Length between 2 and 20 blocks
greate_remake.ponder.belt_tier.text_1: A belt connector joins two tiered shafts of the SAME tier.
greate_remake.ponder.belt_tier.text_2: Same tier: the connector builds the whole belt at once, and the belt scrolls as soon as the shafts turn.
greate_remake.ponder.belt_tier.text_3: Different tiers: the connection is refused outright - no belt, no half-built chain.
greate_remake.ponder.belt_tier.text_4: Belt length is capped by belt_length in greate_remake-server.toml (20 blocks by default).
greate_remake.ponder.belt_transport.head: Using Mechanical Belts for Logistics
greate_remake.ponder.belt_transport.text: Moving belts will transport Items and other Entities
Right-Click with an empty hand to take items off a belt
greate_remake.ponder.cog_speedup.text_1: Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally
greate_remake.ponder.cog_speedup.text_2: Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled
greate_remake.ponder.cog_speedup.text_3: Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved
greate_remake.ponder.cogwheel.text_1: Cogwheels will relay rotation to other adjacent cogwheels
greate_remake.ponder.cogwheel.text_2: Neighbouring shafts connected like this will rotate in opposite directions
greate_remake.ponder.cogwheel_casing.tex: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels
Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs
The Wrench can be used to toggle connections
greate_remake.ponder.crushing_wheels.tex: A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively
Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other
Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed
Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well
greate_remake.ponder.fan_direction.text_: Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input
greate_remake.ponder.fan_processing.head: Processing Items using Encased Fans
greate_remake.ponder.fan_processing.text: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
Items caught in the area will be smelted
Food items thrown here would be incinerated
Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
Some interesting new processing can be done with it
The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
greate_remake.ponder.fan_tier.text_1: The lower fan is ULV (Andesite Alloy). Blasting and smoking work, but washing is locked at this tier.
greate_remake.ponder.fan_tier.text_2: Upgrade to an LV (Steel) fan and the same water is now read as a washing catalyst.
greate_remake.ponder.fan_tier.text_3: Tier also caps the stress of the whole network. Washing turns crushed ore into purified ore via GT's ore washer recipes.
greate_remake.ponder.gearbox.text_1: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
greate_remake.ponder.gearbox.text_2: A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
greate_remake.ponder.gearbox.text_3: Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
greate_remake.ponder.large_cogwheel.head: Relaying rotational force using Large Cogwheels
greate_remake.ponder.large_cogwheel.text: Large cogwheels can connect to each other at right angles
It will help relaying conveyed speed to other axes of rotation
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_mixer.he: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_mixer.te: With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_press.he: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_press.te: The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
When items are provided on a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_press_co: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_pump_flo: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_pump_spe: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_saw_brea: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_saw_cont: Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into
greate_remake.ponder.mechanical_saw_proc: Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead
greate_remake.ponder.millstone.text_1: Millstones process items by grinding them
greate_remake.ponder.millstone.text_2: They can be powered from the side using cogwheels
greate_remake.ponder.millstone.text_3: Throw or Insert items at the top
greate_remake.ponder.millstone.text_4: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
greate_remake.ponder.millstone.text_5: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
greate_remake.ponder.shaft.text_1: Shafts will relay rotation in a straight line.
greate_remake.ponder.shaft_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Shafts
